result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visual/content problems: a suspicious '−100%' discount badge, a restaurant card whose title is clipped at the screen edge, and an empty category chip cut off at the right side.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card shows a '−100%' discount badge, which implies the item is completely free. This is likely a data or calculation error rather than an intended promotion.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount value in the backend/data source; cap or validate discount percentages so implausible values like 100% are flagged or displayed correctly (e.g., 'Free delivery' if that's the intent).

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card's title is truncated mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') with no ellipsis, making the clipping look accidental rather than a designed carousel peek.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis (…) to card titles, or ensure the peeking card's text container is fully within its card bounds.

issues.description: A category filter chip at the far right of the chips row is cut off and appears as an empty sliver, giving a broken look to the filter bar.
issues.suggestion: Add appropriate right padding/inset to the horizontal chip list or a fade-out gradient so partially visible chips clearly read as scrollable content.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar, with its image and text partially hidden behind the nav.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the nav bar height to the scroll container so content isn't obscured; if this is mid-scroll, consider a translucent nav or scroll inset to make the overlap look intentional.
